scope: Documented local production lessons, not new audits or trained weights. Historical paths are evidence only, not publication destinations.

lessons.rule: Preserve scans; distinguish raw OCR, source-compared text, writer approval and publication. Uncertain transcription blocks final release.
Keep stanza, paragraph, chapter and comic-panel order; word counts alone do not prove fidelity.
Preserve author, translator, transcreator, illustrator and original layout credits separately; do not infer missing bibliography.
Review intended character count, identities, props and story meaning as well as anatomy.
Review full-size animal anatomy and propagate approved corrections to every requested output, including PDF.
Keep live text separate from art; review Odia shaping and English typography. Preserve approved historical PDF type choices.
Review each requested format independently; web QA does not establish PDF, EPUB or print quality.
Keep protected review distinct from publicly accessible unlisted links; authorization is candidate-specific.

translation_limit: Credited English translation demonstrates a workflow, not measured bilingual quality. Future human-reviewed English/Odia source-target cases are required for quality evaluation.
